extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 0.5.6: Going back to a list now always shows watched status as it is now. Kodi no longer keeps its own copy of lists that show watched status (films, shows, seasons, episodes, the calendar and Trakt lists), so after marking something watched or unwatched, or watching it, the season and show counts are right. Plain menus are still kept for instant going back. 0.5.5: After you watch something to the end, SpongeTV now also waits for Kodi to finish redrawing the list before reloading it, so the list no longer comes back in Estuary's picture layout (WideList without watched icons). If a reloaded list is ever missing its content type, SpongeTV reloads it once more. 0.5.4: After you watch something to the end, SpongeTV now waits for Kodi to finish saving its own record of the video before reloading the list, so an episode you've just finished shouldn't flash up as part-watched. Kodi's log notes when Kodi saved, when the list reloaded, and how the item you watched shows afterwards. 0.5.3: An episode or film you've finished no longer shows as part-watched because of an old resume point Kodi kept for itself. When you're signed in to Trakt, SpongeTV now tells Kodi there's no resume point, rather than leaving Kodi to fill in its own. Earlier changes: changelog.txt
